About the SSG 08 | Blood in the Water

The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been spray-painted using short pieces of tape as stencils. The SSG 08 | Blood in the Water is a Covert-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Blood in the Water finish on the SSG 08. With a Covert rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.26% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The SSG 08 | Blood in the Water can be unboxed from the CS:GO Weapon Case 2. It belongs to the Arms Deal 2 Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.06 to 0.20. Due to its minimum float of 0.06, this skin cannot drop in Factory New condition. The best available condition is Minimal Wear, which affects both availability and pricing. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The SSG 08 | Blood in the Water (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $301.60, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $100.22 (Field-Tested) to $301.60 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The SSG 08 | Blood in the Water has a community rating of 4.0 out of 5 based on 11,815 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among SSG 08 skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the SSG 08 | Blood in the Water?

Factory New (FN) SSG 08 | Blood in the Water skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. Note: the SSG 08 | Blood in the Water cannot drop in Factory New — its minimum float is 0.06, so the best available condition affects pricing significantly. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Blood in the Water pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the SSG 08 | Blood in the Water worth the price?

The SSG 08 | Blood in the Water sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Blood in the Water design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The Arms Deal 2 Collection, obtainable from the CS:GO Weapon Case 2, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the SSG 08, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the SSG 08 | Blood in the Water?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). This skin cannot be obtained in Factory New condition due to its minimum float of 0.06. The best possible condition is Minimal Wear. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.
